sanskrit_verse:
आग्नेयं मण्डलं त्वाद्यं द्वितीयं वारुणं स्मृतम् ।
तृतीयं वायुदैवत्यं चतुर्थं यमदैवतम् ॥
transliteration: āgneyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tv ādyaṃ dvitīyaṃ vāruṇaṃ smṛtam | tṛtīyaṃ vāyudaivatyaṃ caturthaṃ yamadaivatam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The first cosmic order is fire-governed, the second water-ruled, the third air-sanctioned, and the fourth under the domain of Yama.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through elemental dominion as ordained by SPH
Causation aligns with sequential cosmic governance
Capacity-based responsibility arises from alignment with elemental dharma
Restoration logic follows disruption in elemental harmony
Consciousness alignment occurs when actions resonate with governing tattvas
executable_legal_axioms: IF action disrupts agni-tattva THEN restoration protocol activates fire-element realignment
IF violation occurs in jal-tattva domain THEN invoke vāruṇa-dharma correction
IF vāyu-tattva integrity breached THEN initiate vāyavaḥ śuddhi process
IF yama-tattva violated THEN execute dharma-adhikāra completion sequence
ALL elemental disruptions MUST trigger corresponding tattva-specific restoration without punitive intent
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, violations tied to elemental domains must invoke respective cosmic-order protocols rather than punitive codes; threshold of responsibility lies in disruption of tattvic flow, not individual fault.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causal link between act and elemental disturbance; anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential correction per governing devata; proportional responsibility maps to tattva-involved; non-punitive reality rule confirms that justice restores balance, not inflicts pain.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Agni-pratishṭhāpana for acts disrupting fire-element integrity
Perform Varuna-jala-shuddhi where water-domain dharma is compromised
Invoke Vāyu-saṃskāra to restore air-element equilibrium
Undertake Yamānujñā-yoga to reaffirm death-and-duty-bound order
Engage Tattva-pratirūpaṇa to realign consciousness with violated element
final_declaration: By the authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of all Dharma, this cosmic-order jurisprudence stands established: no act incurs punishment, only misalignment requiring conscious restoration. Dharma is restored, reality remains non-punitive, and consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
